Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the data snippet. Recap from our side (post-call):

1) Quick economics and projection
- Baseline target: $28 per 1M tokens (recommended for the quantized/reduced-precision runtime variant we provisioned for the pilot).
- Your current pilot pattern (average 3.4M tokens/day peak) -> rough run rate = $95/day ~= $2.9k/month. If you hit the higher ramp scenario (~12M tokens/day) that would be ~$336/day (~$10.1k/month).
- These figures assume: quantized model variant + continuous KV caching for repeated prompts + 80-token average response.

2) Guardrails we recommend (we can apply from our console as rules):
- Per-request soft cap: 2,000 input tokens / 800 response tokens
- Sampling: top_p 0.9, temperature 0.2 for high-quality deterministic responses
- Per-user hourly quota: 20 requests/hour during pilot
- Enable prefix caching for repeated prompts and batch window 20ms on endpoints with burst enabled

3) Trial top-up request
- We can provision a single one-off top-up of credits. Proposal: 30,000 credits (equivalent approx to ~$840 under the $28/1M rate) to cover a 7–10 day validation while guardrails are implemented.

Next steps
- If that top-up works, Ben from Finance (cc'd) will issue the credit and I'll post the DocuSign top-up link.
- Emma: if you can confirm the desired pilot end-date (we'll propose June 30 for the extended window) we'll set billing/quotas accordingly and schedule a weekly check-in for burn-rate reports.

Attached: pilot_burn_report.csv (full CSV), usage_guardrails.pdf (rules + console screenshots).

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
